sections.executive_summary: The quant stack is still seeding: five archived history runs exist, but backtest horizons lack paired runs, historical analysis has no strategy results, and offline simulation shows all active tracks trailing benchmark over five periods. Forward paper evidence is mixed but directionally better for the primary track: **ai_judgment** beats the **rules** control after costs (-5.06% vs -14.24% excess) yet still underperforms the market (verdict: underperforming; beat_market=false). Churn is the dominant drag on the control book (10.7% cost drag, 23 trades) while the primary book is quieter (2.9% cost drag, 5 trades). The single biggest modelling/analysis gap this week is **insufficient archived evidence depth** — no backtest horizon pairs, no historical strategy rankings, zero exit-shadow closed cohorts, and thin epoch marks on most tracks — so forward paper P&L cannot yet be validated against offline signal research.
sections.performance_diagnosis:
- **Primary (ai_judgment) vs market:** excess_after_costs **-5.06%** (benchmark_return 2.15%; total_return -2.91%); beat_market=false.
- **Control (rules) vs market:** excess_after_costs **-14.24%** (benchmark_return 3.26%; total_return -10.98%); primary beats control (beat_control=true) but both lose to benchmark on reported spans.
- **Cost drag:** rules **10.7%** (£107.10 on £1,000 contributed, 23 trades); ai_judgment **2.9%** (£29.15, 5 trades); momentum_grace **2.9%** (£29.15, 5 trades); technical **0.87%** (£8.71, 3 trades).
- **Offline sim (5 periods, archived):** research_overlay excess **-3.67%** (20 trades, £64.55 costs); momentum_grace sim excess **-1.02%** (19 trades); static/trailing_levels excess **-0.3%** (0 trades). Research overlay note: identical returns to screen-only over this window.
- **Mark thickness:** ai_judgment has **5 equity_marks** and enough_history=true; rules has **6 marks** and a fresh knob epoch (epoch equity_marks=0, benchmark span insufficient); momentum_grace and technical each have **2 lifetime marks** (enough_history=false). Exit-shadow has **0 closed exits** on all tracks. Marks are **not thick enough** to trust cross-track attribution or exit-quality conclusions; primary/control lifetime marks are usable for coarse cost/churn comparison only.
- Rules decision review **applied** min_conviction 0.40→0.45 for high cost drag; **do not treat that as a recommendation to auto-apply further decision-review knobs** — engineering promotion remains manual per guardrails.

sections.proposed_experiments:
1. [offline_sim] Archive-lab replay of rules rebalance_log vs ai_judgment gates over 2026-07-20→2026-08-07 window — quantify how much of rules underperformance is conviction/churn vs AI accumulate/adjusted_signal (rules counterfactual already shows +4.49% return delta vs actual on partial replay).
2. [paper_churn] Hold-buffer + exit_confirm_screens counterfactual on rules track with min_conviction=0.45 epoch — test whether buffered_holdings (3 names, exit_streak=1) reduce flip churn without waiting for auto-apply.
3. [paper_knobs] Human-gated momentum_grace max_positions 5→4 lifetime replay — validate proposed 0.58% cost_drag reduction and -2.88% excess baseline before any apply (graduates_at_acted_entries=2).
4. [monitoring] Weekly archive completeness gate (prices + model snapshots + run pairs) — unblock historical_analysis top_strategies and backtest top_horizons once run_count pairs exist across horizons.
5. [analysis] Exit-shadow cohort bootstrap — ingest closed exits across ai_judgment vs momentum_grace once sells occur; compare grace_closed vs screen_rotation_closed post-exit paths (currently 0 closed on all tracks).
